QuestInfo.name: The Snow Child
QuestInfo.0: Gared's daughter #bBitsie#k says that she is a friend of the snow monster, who is really a boy named #bEdward#k. Is it truly possible to be friends with the savage creature plaguing the village?\r\nBitsie wants you to meet with the boy to prove he is not the threat everyone believes. Is her friend truly innocent, or is that only what she wants to believe? You decide to find out.
